exposure: Control group (women without any thyroid disease or malignant tumor)
conception by in vitro fertilization/intracytoplasmic injection
Conception by in vitro fertilization/intracytoplasmic injection
cohort: Women with a history of thyroid cancer who had a live birth and a control group of women without any thyroid disease or malignant tumor
finding: Pregnant women with a history of thyroid cancer did not have a higher risk of most adverse obstetric outcomes except for abnormally invasive placentation.
